# Code of conduct

Short version: be decent.

- Be respectful. Criticise code, not people.
- Assume good faith. Most disagreements are misunderstandings.
- Keep discussion on topic and in English where possible, so others can follow.
- No harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, or spam.
- Respect people's privacy: don't post someone else's personal data, chats or screenshots
  without their consent.

Maintainers may edit, lock, or delete comments and issues that break these rules, and may block
repeat offenders.

If someone's behaviour is a problem, contact the maintainers privately rather than escalating in
public — through GitHub, via a private
[security advisory](https://github.com/FastgramApp/Fastgram-iOS/security/advisories/new) if you
need a private channel.
